ns2:section.sectionText: **Due to the high demand for this core course by our Information Science majors, we will not have extra seats available or give overrides to non-IS majors during the fall 2022 semester, please check back during the spring 2023 semester. Students must register for the lecture and one lab. Restricted to Information Sciences majors. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
